item_short_desc: Rothco's Web Belts are constructed from resilient high-density cotton canvas, these belts are fully adjustable up to 74 inches. Easily customize the length by cutting for a perfect fit. The secure metal buckle ensures reliability, and the detachable buckle allows for personalized style. Measuring 1.25” wide, these belts are versatile, fitting BDU pants, cargo shorts, uniforms, jeans, and more.
